name: suede-seo-audit
description: Suede AI technical and on-page SEO audit with a generative search lane. Runs nine evidence-based lanes on a live page or site: crawl and index access, search intent, metadata, structure and internal links, supported schema, answer extractability, copy, E-E-A-T, and topic clusters, then grades each A-F and writes exact rewrite fixes, JSON-LD, and KPIs to watch. Use when the audit itself is the deliverable: traffic drops, pre-launch SEO checks, indexation problems, schema errors, Core Web Vitals r
author: JasonColapietro
